runs.text: Five thousand dollars of software, sold abroad, for every person in one country. This is software and IT exports, per person, since two thousand and five. In two thousand and five, Israel already sells six hundred seventy five dollars a head. Britain, two fifty. By twenty fifteen, Israel is at nineteen hundred dollars a person. Saudi Arabia sells oil. Its software exports? Sixty one dollars a person. Turkey, sixty two. Egypt, fifteen. Jordan, four. America has Silicon Valley, but it is huge. Two hundred sixty four dollars per American. Britain, eight hundred sixty four. Germany, six sixty. Chips too: thirty seven percent of Israel's factory exports are high tech. Should Israel bet even more on tech? Tell me in the comments. So how much code does one Israeli sell the world? Five thousand one hundred eighty dollars.
